pax_corptimizer_title: Pax Corptimizer — what slows the game
pax_corptimizer_live:
FPS %s · usual frame %s ms · worst %s ms · spikes per second %s

pax_corptimizer_analyze_tip:
The analysis switches suspects off one by one (armies, bases, map
layers, icons, lines, 3D, mods, time flow, rarer layer redraws) for 2.5
seconds and measures the frame. Open the map where it lags, start time
and do not touch the mouse or windows until it ends.
pax_corptimizer_started: Analysis started — results in the «Optimize» window and in this console.
pax_corptimizer_layer_show_foreign_tip:
Other countries' armies on the map. Turn off if the map lags: armies
disappear only from the map, wars and marches go on as usual.
pax_corptimizer_layer_show_own_tip:
Your armies on the map. Hidden armies cannot be clicked, but you can
still give them orders in words.
pax_corptimizer_layer_show_bases_tip: Military base markers on the map.
pax_corptimizer_t_layers: All map layers of the Tab window
pax_corptimizer_skip_cover_tip:
While time is skipped the map's drawing pauses and a screen drawn by the
GPU is shown. The one busy CPU core computes the world instead of
drawing the map.
pax_corptimizer_skip_3d_tip:
Also switch off 3D (the planet and space) during skips — a little more
CPU for the world.
pax_corptimizer_skip_hint: The map is paused — the CPU is computing the world. Everything comes back after the skip.
pax_corptimizer_r_triggers: What coincides with the heavy map redraws (share of redraws / precision): %s.
pax_corptimizer_r_corp: Pax Corporations week (last): %s ms in total, spread over frames, heavy parts on all cores.
pax_corptimizer_r_skip: Time skip: %s frames, %s ms on average, worst %s ms.
pax_corptimizer_r_base: Usual frame %s ms (%s FPS on average), 95%% of frames faster than %s ms, worst %s ms. Spikes over 33 ms: %s per second.
pax_corptimizer_why_mods: Spikes are in mods' code (their _process, before the game's code).
pax_corptimizer_why_main: Spikes are in the game's own code (Main: world, wars, economy, AI).
pax_corptimizer_why_ui: Spikes are in the game's windows and UI.
pax_corptimizer_why_map: Spikes are in the map update (its _process: layers, icons, armies recomputed).
pax_corptimizer_why_rest: Spikes are in code that runs after the map (mods' map layers and other nodes).
pax_corptimizer_why_draw: Spikes are in drawing (_draw functions: map icons, lines, labels) right after the code.
pax_corptimizer_why_render: Spikes are in rendering (sending the frame to the GPU).
pax_corptimizer_why_gap: Spikes are between frames: input, physics or waiting for the system/GPU.
pax_corptimizer_r_tests: Each suspect: usual frame with it → without it; spikes per second with it → without it.
pax_corptimizer_r_session: In %s s of play, spikes: over 33 ms — %s, over 50 ms — %s, over 100 ms — %s.
pax_corptimizer_r_steps: Simulation steps: %s (days: %s). A frame with a step takes %s ms on average, worst %s ms.
pax_corptimizer_r_redraws: How often map parts are redrawn (share of frames): %s.
pax_corptimizer_r_counts: Nodes %s (orphans %s) · units in the world %s · on the map: army stacks %s, bases %s, province icons %s.
pax_corptimizer_layer_slow_tip:
The map redraws its layer icons (20–80 ms each time) whenever its layer
timer fires. The mod stretches the timer — fewer redraws, fewer spikes,
slower icon animation. «Auto» measures what a redraw costs and keeps it
within ~4% of the time.
pax_corptimizer_no_3d_map_tip:
While the map is open the planet and space behind it are not seen but
still drawn (~2.5 ms a frame). This switches 3D off while the map is
open.
pax_corptimizer_r_screen: Skip screen: shown %s times (%s frames), last skip flag — %s, place — %s.
pax_corptimizer_fps_cap_tip:
The game draws without a limit (200+ frames a second) and keeps the main
thread always busy. A limit evens out the frames and gives the spare
time to the system, the driver and the worker threads. It does not
remove spikes by itself.

pax_corptimizer_upscale_tip:
The 3D world is drawn at a lower resolution and scaled up to the screen — lighter for the video card (most of all with Pax CorpInc3D's 3D Earth). The interface is not scaled.
FSR 1.0 — fast, no frame history. FSR 2.2 — sharper, uses frame history (Forward+ renderer only). MetalFX — on Mac.
DLSS and XeSS are not in the Godot engine: they need a native library only the game itself can add.
pax_corptimizer_upscale_dlss: NVIDIA DLSS — not in the engine
pax_corptimizer_upscale_xess: Intel XeSS — not in the engine
pax_corptimizer_upscale_na_engine: Not in the Godot engine: it needs a native library (GDExtension) only the game can add.
pax_corptimizer_upscale_na_renderer: Not available with the game's current renderer or on this system.
pax_corptimizer_aa_tip: FXAA — cheap and soft, SMAA — sharper, TAA — from frame history (built into FSR 2.2 and temporal MetalFX).
pax_corptimizer_whatsnew_2_2_0:

• DLSS and XeSS are listed but off: the Godot engine does not have them, only the game itself can add them.
pax_corptimizer_lod_tip: The farther the camera from the planet, the coarser the textures (smaller mip levels) — from afar the detail is not seen, and the video card reads less. At the ground — as in the game. The models are simplified by Pax CorpInc3D itself (buildings → blocks).
pax_corptimizer_icons_lod_tip: From afar Pax Corporations gets only the largest companies (closer — more, close in — all); while the map moves, the marks are redrawn less often. Less load on the processor.
pax_corptimizer_lod_now: Now: distance %d%%, textures +%.1f mip, models ×%.1f; marks %d of %d
pax_corptimizer_threads: Multithreading: the mods' heavy work on other cores
pax_corptimizer_threads_tip: The companies' economy and statuses (Pax Corporations), the cities' houses, the roads and networks, the Earth's big maps (Pax CorpInc3D) are computed on background threads — the game does not freeze. Switch it off only if you suspect the threads of crashes: then all of it runs on the main thread, with pauses.
pax_corptimizer_threads_info: Processor cores: %d, for background work: %d. On threads: the corporations' economy and statuses, the 3D cities, the 3D roads and networks, the NASA maps. The game's own computations cannot be moved by a mod — that would mean changing the game's scripts.
